verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API documentation shows extensive, granular coverage of nearly all platform capabilities (cards, users, businesses, card products, velocity/authorization controls, transactions, disputes, webhooks, JIT funding, card state transitions, sandbox simulations), consistent with an API-first product where the API is the primary interface rather than a UI-first tool. However, the evidence never explicitly states that every function available in Marqeta's dashboard/UI is also exposed via API, nor is there independent corroboration or a feature-parity statement. Missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API parity documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
